custody.integration: Attach source-coordinate geometry and generated atlas to the existing mesh. Preserve authored colour/alpha/roughness maps, UVs, wind shaders, rig parents, instance matrices and custom depth material. Reference previews show raw surface geometry; runtime appearance acceptance remains separate.

exactLocalCorrection.method: Actual current geometry constructor attributes, expanded in authored triangle order; normalized corner directions. Forklift decoded from its licensed GLB with normalized accessor decoding, node forklift-base-24. Original unpaid roundtrip artifacts retained separately.

redundantFaceRemoval.invariants: Exact coincident positions, cyclic winding, corner normals, palette, material and shadow flags; no authored UV map exists. Kept one copy of every identical opaque source face. Licensed original GLB retained unchanged.
